content: प्रायः [प्र-अय् घञ्, इ-अच् वा] .²1 Going away, departure, departure from life. .²2 Seeking death by fasting, fasting, sitting down and abstaining from food with some object in view (generally with words like आस्, उपविश् <ab>&c.</ab>); see प्रायोपवेशन below; प्रायोपविष्टं गङ्गायां परीतं परमर्षिभिः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 3. 43</ls>. .²3 The largest portion, majority, plurality; majority of cases. .²4 Excess, abundance, plenty. .²5 A condition of life. [{%<ab>N. B.</ab>%}:-- At the end of <ab>comp.</ab> प्राय may be translated by .³({%a%}) for the most part, generally, mostly, almost, nearly; पतनप्रायौ ‘about to fall’; मृतप्रायः ‘almost dead, a little less than dead, nearly dead’; or .³({%b%}) abounding or rich in, full of, excessive, abundant; कष्टप्रायं शरीरम् <ls>U. 1</ls>; शालिप्रायो देशः <ls>Pt. 3</ls>; कमलामोदप्राया वनानिलाः <ls>U. 3. 24</ls> ‘full of the fragrance’ <ab>&c.</ab>, or .³({%c%}) like, resembling; वर्षशतप्रायं दिनम्, अमृतप्रायं वचनम् <ab>&c.</ab>]
